description: This file implements functions for formatting and handling invalid argument errors in the PyTorch C++ codebase, including parsing argument options, matching argument types, and generating detailed error messages.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Abstract base class for different argument type matchers.

classes.name: SimpleType
classes.description: Represents a simple type identified by name, matching against PyObject type name.

classes.name: MultiType
classes.description: Represents multiple accepted types, matching if the object's type name is in the list.

classes.name: NullableType
classes.description: Wraps another type to allow matching Py_None or the wrapped type.

classes.name: TupleType
classes.description: Represents a tuple of specific types, matching if the PyObject is a tuple with matching element types.

classes.name: SequenceType
classes.description: Represents a sequence of a specific type, matching if the PyObject is a sequence with matching element types.

classes.name: Argument
classes.description: Represents a function argument with a name and type.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Represents a set of argument options, including arguments, variadic flag, and out parameter flag.

methods.name: py_typename
methods.description: Returns the type name of a PyObject.

methods.name: _splitString
methods.description: Splits a string by a delimiter into tokens.

methods.name: _buildType
methods.description: Constructs a Type object based on a type name string and nullability.

methods.name: _parseOption
methods.description: Parses an option string into an Option object and a printable string.

methods.name: _argcountMatch
methods.description: Checks if the number of arguments matches the expected count for an option.

methods.name: _formattedArgDesc
methods.description: Formats a detailed description of arguments with type matching info.

methods.name: _argDesc
methods.description: Formats a simple description of arguments.

methods.name: _tryMatchKwargs
methods.description: Attempts to match provided kwargs to expected argument names.

methods.name: format_invalid_args
methods.description: Generates a detailed error message for invalid argument combinations.
